sections.title: The Letters — ب to ز
sections.hint: Each letter: its name and its picture, then fat-ha, damma and kasra — then a sukoon after نَ.

sections.title: The Letters — س to ق
sections.hint: Each letter: its name and its picture, then fat-ha, damma and kasra — then a sukoon after نَ.

sections.title: The Letters — ك to هـ
sections.hint: Each letter: its name and its picture, then fat-ha, damma and kasra — then a sukoon after نَ.

sections.title: The Letters — و ى ا ء
sections.hint: و and ى, then the alif — a letter of madd — then the hamza. Take them slowly.

words.name: بَاء
words.mnemonic: A boat, with one bubble below it
words.script: This is the letter baa. It looks like a boat with one bubble below it. It sounds like the English letter b, as in boat. With a fat-ha it sounds like baa, with a damma boo, with a kasra bee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nab (نَبۡ). Now your turn. Say it.

words.name: تَاء
words.mnemonic: The same boat, with two bubbles above it
words.script: This is the letter taa. It looks like the same boat, with two bubbles on top. It sounds like the English letter t, as in tea. With a fat-ha it sounds like taa, with a damma too, with a kasra tee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nat (نَتۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: ثَاء
words.mnemonic: The same boat, with three bubbles above it
words.script: This is the letter thaa. It looks like the same boat, with three bubbles on top. It sounds like the beginning of the number three. With a fat-ha it sounds like thaa, with a damma thoo, with a kasra thee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nath (نَثۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: جِيم
words.mnemonic: A crescent moon on its back, one bubble inside it
words.script: This is the letter jeem. It looks like a crescent moon lying on its back, with one bubble inside it. It sounds like the English letter j, as in jam. With a fat-ha it sounds like jaa, with a damma joo, with a kasra jee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naj (نَجۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: حَاء
words.mnemonic: The same crescent moon, empty
words.script: This is the letter ḥaa. It looks like the same crescent moon, with no bubbles at all. There is no letter like it in English: it is a soft breath from the throat. With a fat-ha it sounds like ḥaa, with a damma ḥoo, with a kasra ḥee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naḥ (نَحۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: خَاء
words.mnemonic: The same crescent moon, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter khaa. It looks like the same crescent moon, with one bubble on top. It sounds like snoring. With a fat-ha it sounds like khaa, with a damma khoo, with a kasra khee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nakh (نَخۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: دَال
words.mnemonic: A fishing hook hanging high on its line — it stays up on the line
words.script: This is the letter daal. It looks like a fishing hook hanging high on its line. It sounds like the English letter d, as in door. With a fat-ha it sounds like daa, with a damma doo, with a kasra dee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nad (نَدۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: ذَال
words.mnemonic: The same hanging hook, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter dhaal. It looks like the same hanging hook, with one bubble on top. It sounds like the th in this and that. With a fat-ha it sounds like dhaa, with a damma dhoo, with a kasra dhee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nadh (نَذۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: رَاء
words.mnemonic: The same hook, down on the sand — this one dips below the line
words.script: This is the letter raa. It looks like a fishing hook lying down on the sand. It sounds like the Spanish r, erreh. With a fat-ha it sounds like raa, with a damma roo, with a kasra ree. With a sukoon after نَ it is nar (نَرۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: زَاي
words.mnemonic: The hook on the sand, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter zaay. It looks like the same hook on the sand, with one bubble on top. It sounds like the English letter z, as in zoo. With a fat-ha it sounds like zaa, with a damma zoo, with a kasra zee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naz (نَزۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: سِين
words.mnemonic: A sea snake with three humps
words.script: This is the letter seen. It looks like a sea snake with three humps. It sounds like the English letter s, as in snake. With a fat-ha it sounds like saa, with a damma soo, with a kasra see. With a sukoon after نَ it is nas (نَسۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: شِين
words.mnemonic: The same snake, three bubbles above it
words.script: This is the letter sheen. It looks like the same snake, with three bubbles on top. It sounds like sh, as in ship. With a fat-ha it sounds like shaa, with a damma shoo, with a kasra shee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nash (نَشۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: صَاد
words.mnemonic: A whale — round body, long flat tail
words.script: This is the letter ṣaad. It looks like a whale with a long flat tail. It is a heavy s: close to the s in sauce. With a fat-ha it sounds like ṣaa, with a damma ṣoo, with a kasra ṣee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naṣ (نَصۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: ضَاد
words.mnemonic: The same whale, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter ḍaad. It looks like the same whale, with one bubble on top. It is a heavy d, with the tongue wide and pressed against the side teeth. There is no letter like it in English — Arabic is called the language of the ḍaad. With a fat-ha it sounds like ḍaa, with a damma ḍoo, with a kasra ḍee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naḍ (نَضۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: طَاء
words.mnemonic: The same whale, spouting water straight up
words.script: This is the letter ṭaa. It looks like the whale spouting water straight up. It is a heavy t, close to the t in tart. With a fat-ha it sounds like ṭaa, with a damma ṭoo, with a kasra ṭee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naṭ (نَطۡ). Now your turn. Say it.

words.name: ظَاء
words.mnemonic: The spouting whale, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter ẓaa. It looks like the same spouting whale, with one bubble on top. It is a heavy dhaal, said with a full mouth. With a fat-ha it sounds like ẓaa, with a damma ẓoo, with a kasra ẓee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naẓ (نَظۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: عَيۡن
words.mnemonic: A curled seaweed frond — a backwards 3
words.script: This is the letter ʿayn. It looks like a curly seaweed frond, or a backwards three. There is no letter like it in English. It comes from throat. With a fat-ha it sounds like ʿaa, with a damma ʿoo, with a kasra ʿee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naʿ (نَعۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: غَيۡن
words.mnemonic: The same frond, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter ghayn. It looks like the same curly frond, with one bubble on top. It sounds like gargling water — or the French r. With a fat-ha it sounds like ghaa, with a damma ghoo, with a kasra ghee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nagh (نَغۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: فَاء
words.mnemonic: A fishing net — a hoop with a handle — one bubble above
words.script: This is the letter faa. It looks like a fishing net with a handle, with one bubble on top. It sounds like the English letter f, as in fish. With a fat-ha it sounds like faa, with a damma foo, with a kasra fee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naf (نَفۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: قَاف
words.mnemonic: The same net, deeper, two bubbles above it
words.script: This is the letter qaaf. It looks like the same net, deeper, with two bubbles on top. It is a deep k from the very back of the throat, like the caw of a crow. No letter in English is quite like it. With a fat-ha it sounds like qaa, with a damma qoo, with a kasra qee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naq (نَقۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: كَاف
words.mnemonic: A deck chair, a cushion in the angle
words.script: This is the letter kaaf. It looks like a deck chair with a cushion in it. It sounds like the English letter k, as in kite. With a fat-ha it sounds like kaa, with a damma koo, with a kasra kee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nak (نَكۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: لَام
words.mnemonic: A snorkel
words.script: This is the letter laam. It looks like a snorkel. It sounds like the English letter l, as in lemon. With a fat-ha it sounds like laa, with a damma loo, with a kasra lee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nal (نَلۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: مِيم
words.mnemonic: A buoy, its rope to its left
words.script: This is the letter meem. It looks like a buoy with its rope to its left. It sounds like the English letter m, as in moon. With a fat-ha it sounds like maa, with a damma moo, with a kasra mee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nam (نَمۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: نُون
words.mnemonic: A round half-shell like a bowl, one bubble above it
words.script: This is the letter noon. It looks like a round bowl with one bubble on top. It sounds like the English letter n, as in nose. With a fat-ha it sounds like naa, with a damma noo, with a kasra nee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nan (نَنۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: هَاء
words.mnemonic: A knot tied in a rope
words.script: This is the letter haa. It looks like a knot in a rope. It sounds like the English letter h, as in hat. With a fat-ha it sounds like haa, with a damma hoo, with a kasra hee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nah (نَهۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: وَاو
words.mnemonic: A tadpole
words.script: This is the letter waw. It looks like a tadpole. It sounds like the English letter w, as in wing. With a fat-ha it sounds like waa, with a damma woo, with a kasra wee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naw (نَوۡ). Now your turn.

words.name: يَاء
words.mnemonic: A duck
words.tip: At the beginning of a word, ى changes its shape to يـ and takes two dots below it.

flip.mnemonic: The duck jumps into the boat — two bubbles below
flip.prompt: Tap me to see how I change shape at the beginning of a word

words.script: This is the letter yaa. It looks like a duck floating on the water. It sounds like the English letter y, as in yes. With a fat-ha it sounds like yaa, with a damma yoo, with a kasra yee. With a sukoon after نَ it is nay (نَىۡ). At the beginning of a word the duck jumps into the boat and gets two dots under it — يـ. Now your turn.

words.name: أَلِف
words.mnemonic: A lighthouse
words.tip: Alif comes after a letter with a fat-ha and makes that fat-ha longer. That is why it is called a letter of madd — madd means to make longer.
words.script: This is the letter alif. It looks like a lighthouse — tall and straight. Alif has no sound of its own: it comes after a letter with a fat-ha and makes that fat-ha longer. That is why it is called a letter of madd — madd means to make longer. Listen: baa, taa, thaa. Now your turn.

words.name: هَمۡزَة
words.mnemonic: A wave crest curling over
words.script: This is the letter hamza. It looks like a little wave curling over. It’s the sound when you say uh-oh. With a fat-ha it sounds like ʾa, with a damma ʾoo, with a kasra ʾee. With a sukoon after نَ it is naʾ, sitting up on an alif (نَأۡ). Now your turn.
